summary: Gordon only said hello to June Tyson, seeing her in Egyptian garb at Sun Ra's house.

blocks.x: Yeah absolutely. So I had a few more questions relating to Sun Ra and your experience working with him and the Arkestra. Did you ever have much interaction with June Tyson?
No, only to say hello. To me she was like a Goddess. Like a couple times when I was at Sun Ra’s place she was there too. And she was in garb. She was wearing you know some © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-

kind of Egyptian headwear and like I saw her running around the house and she might have been doing mundane things to help out Sun Ra but she was still a Goddess so no I didn’t approach her. You know. No.
